coverageCaveat: Area-level network availability is inferred from Durham-wide figures (broadband.co.uk, updated 2026-09-21: FTTC/superfast 98%, full fibre 91%, Virgin Media 52%) and Openreach's County Durham update (2026-08-03). No street- or postcode-level confirmation was obtainable; always label as 'check your postcode' in the demo.

gilesgate.label: Gilesgate
gilesgate.notes: Urban Durham city suburb. Openreach FTTC near-universal; full fibre likely on most streets given 91% Durham FTTP figure. Virgin Media covers ~52% of Durham so may or may not reach a given street. No altnet (CityFibre, Netomnia, Brsk, Hey!, Zzoomm, Freedom Fibre etc.) build found for DH1.

viaduct.label: Viaduct
viaduct.notes: Dense terraced student area by the station. Same Durham-city network mix as Gilesgate. No altnet coverage found.

cityCentre.label: City Centre / Claypath
cityCentre.notes: Historic centre: conservation-area flats/terraces can lag on full fibre installs. Purpose-built student blocks usually include broadband in rent (check before budgeting). No altnet coverage found.

langleyMoor.label: Langley Moor
langleyMoor.notes: Village ~3 miles SW of the city, outside the Durham-city figures. Openreach says ~72% of County Durham has gigabit/full fibre (Aug 2026), so FTTP is plausible but not confirmed. No Virgin Media, nexfibre or altnet build announcement found naming Langley Moor/Brandon. 4G/5G home broadband is a fallback option.

providers.name: BT Student Broadband (9-month)
providers.notes: Student Fibre Essential tier, Sept-June term with no rollover, plus £35 setup, needs .ac.uk email. Price is from Selectra's May 2026 table (2025/26 lineup); other tiers are £35 (67Mbps), £40 (150Mbps) and £45 (500Mbps). Not confirmed on bt.com (student page 404). Save the Student says the 9-month deal may not currently be offered, so treat it as indicative.

providers.name: Virgin Media Student M125
providers.notes: Advertised as 'from £26.99', 12 months, £0 setup, needs .ac.uk email, Virgin network areas only (~52% of Durham). Also M500 £30.99 (516Mbps) and Gig1 £35.99. The legal text gives the offer end as '13th August' with no year, so it may have expired. Non-students get 30-day rolling deals instead. Langley Moor coverage unverified.

providers.name: NOW Full Fibre 75
providers.notes: Uses the Openreach network. Today the provider site shows only 24-month terms: £23 (75), £25 (100), £28 (300), £0 setup. Selectra (May 2026) listed a 12-month NOW plan at £21 and a rolling one at £28, but NOW's site doesn't show them now. Needs full fibre at the address.

providers.name: Vodafone Full Fibre 150
providers.notes: Cheapest headline full fibre deal in the broadband.co.uk Durham listing (page updated 2026-09-21). £0 setup and £120 voucher, rising in April 2027 and 2028. A 24-month term doesn't fit a 12-month student tenancy (early exit fees).

providers.name: Cuckoo Full Fibre (no contract)
providers.notes: Price unavailable: cuckoo.co only shows prices after a postcode is entered. Plans are Full Fibre 150/500/900 with £0 setup. Selectra (May 2026) listed a Cuckoo rolling-monthly 67Mbps plan at £26, but that plan isn't on Cuckoo's current lineup, so it isn't used here. Known for no-contract options, which suits students.

fallbackMonthlyEstimateGBP.note: Typical household broadband cost used when no specific deal applies. About £31/month average UK home broadband bill in 2026 (this source cites Uswitch/Ofcom; Broadband Genie gives £30.84). Entry-level deals run ~£21-25.
